name: Dr Ali Schnabel
title: Psychologist
description: I strive to be an inclusive practitioner and to create a culturally sensitive, LGBTQIA+ and sex work safe space in therapy. Outside of private practice, I currently work at a publicly funded Centre Against Sexual Assault providing therapy to victim/survivors of sexual violence. In a previous role at a public youth mental health service for young people with severe mental health difficulties, I had the opportunity to diagnose and support many young women and gender diverse people with previously undiagnosed adult autism. Listed areas/modalities: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual Abuse, Sexuality, Trauma.
specialties: gender diverse, lgbtiq, lgbtqia+, non-binary, sex, sexual, sexuality, trauma, traumatic

name: Mx Lumen Gorrie
title: Psychologist
description: I provide identity-affirming care to LGBTQIASBP+ community members, neurodivergent folk (especially ADHD and/or Autistic), chronically ill folk, and disabled folk. I work from an intersectional, anti-oppressive, de-pathologising, identity-affirming, trauma-informed, and anti-diet framework. The main services I offer include psychological counselling/therapy, WPATH assessment, and Autism assessment for clients, and consultation/training/supervision for other health professionals and educators (topics of gender, sexuality, neurodivergence, chronic health, disability, and/or eating), and I aspire to provide a space where all folks' needs, felt safety, and comfort are supported. Listed areas/modalities: Sexual identity, LGBTI issues.
specialties: lgbti, lgbtiq, lgbtqiasbp+, non-binary, sexual, sexuality, trauma, wpath
identity: Non-binary trans (Halaxy gender field); pronouns they/them

name: Kim Tran
title: Psychologist
description: Kim has a special interest in trauma, grief/loss, anxiety/depression, parenting support, Culturally and Linguistically Diverse (CALD) related issues, interrelationship problems, and neuro-diverse clients with ASD and ADHD. Modes of therapy that Kim uses include EMDR, Schema Therapy, CBT & ACT. Listed areas/modalities: Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR).

name: Ms Robyn Ming
title: Psychologist
description: She is a Clinical Psychologist, experienced in the assessment and treatment of a range of mental health issues, including anxiety and mood disorders; post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD); gender dysphoria; acute stress and other adjustment disorders; alcohol and other drugs; grief and loss; borderline personality and other axis II disorders. Robyn has a particular interest in working with the LGBTQIA+ community, providing a safe, non-judgemental space to explore issues related to gender and sexuality. She has previously worked at a specialist LGBTQIA+ service and provides gender affirmative care. Robyn is able to conduct WPATH assessments for people accessing gender affirming treatments such as hormone therapy and surgery. Listed areas/modalities: Schema Therapy, LGBTI issues, Schema Therapy, Sexual identity.
specialties: gender affirmative, gender affirming, lgbti, lgbtiq, lgbtqia+, non-binary, schema, sexual, sexuality, trauma, traumatic, wpath

name: Marie Vakakis
title: Social Worker
description: Marie has specialist knowledge in understanding and treating adolescent psychological distress, working with trauma, mental health issues, school refusal and family work. Marie has undertaken professional development in models including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Strengths Based approaches, Trauma training including EMDR, Motivational Interviewing, Emotionally Focused Couples Therapy, Level 1 Gottman training and is completing a Masters of Family Therapy. Marie also works with children, adolescents and adults who are gender-diverse, and works closely with services to support individuals and families through this process.

name: Miss Semhar Hagoss
title: Psychologist
description: I integrate a trauma-informed and intersectional framework into my practice. I utilise a variety of modalities and collaborate with clients to choose the best approach, drawing from methods such as Narrative Therapy, Trauma-focused CBT, Internal Family Systems, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Complicated Grief Therapy, and Family Therapy.
